name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
summary: At Brackenwall Village, Krog awaits Lieutenant Paval Reethe's badge and news of the Shady Rest Inn.

sections.title: A Glint in the Rubble
sections.body: Beneath rubble and brush, you find a badge marked with Theramore's sign. Ash and debris cover it, but Lieutenant Paval Reethe's name is embossed below the golden anchor. Krog waits at Brackenwall Village. He asks whether you have learned what befell the Shady Rest Inn.

sections.title: What Krog Knows
sections.body: Krog calls Paval Reethe a pathetic human who abandoned the soldiers he served with. Now Reethe hides in the woods. Krog suspects him of stealing supplies, so he sent Ogron to track him down. Others share that suspicion. Krog thinks Ogron was seen heading southeast.

faq.answer: The badge bears Theramore's sign, a golden anchor over white enamel. Lieutenant Paval Reethe's name is embossed beneath it.

aliases: who do i bring the badge to
faq.answer: Bring the badge to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
You found the badge beneath rubble, caked in ash and debris. Krog asks whether you have learned what befell the Shady Rest Inn.

attribution: Classic quest text: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
